dialogues.jp: 「ただいま」
dialogues.en: "I'm home."
dialogues.text: "I'm home."

dialogues.jp: 健全な帰宅部として、真っ直ぐ家に帰ってくる。
dialogues.en:
I went straight home as a healthy student with no after
school activities.
dialogues.text:
I went straight home as a healthy student with no after
school activities.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「おかえりなさ〜い」
dialogues.en: "Welcome back."
dialogues.text: "Welcome back."

dialogues.jp: 居間から声が響いてくる。
dialogues.en: She yelled out from the living room.
dialogues.text: She yelled out from the living room.

dialogues.jp:
あいかわらず、家に帰るときの音夢の行動力だ
けは不思議だ。
dialogues.en:
It's a wonder how she only becomes active when she gets to
go home from school.
dialogues.text:
It's a wonder how she only becomes active when she gets to
go home from school.

dialogues.jp: 本当にわき目も振らず帰ってきているのだろう。
dialogues.en:
She must be coming straight home without looking at
anything.
dialogues.text:
She must be coming straight home without looking at
anything.

dialogues.jp: 「ただいま」
dialogues.en: "Hey, I'm home."
dialogues.text: "Hey, I'm home."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「お帰り兄さん。早かったね」
dialogues.en: "Welcome back, niisan. You came home fast."
dialogues.text: "Welcome back, niisan. You came home fast."

dialogues.jp:
机の上に便箋を広げて、音夢がにっこりと微笑
む。
dialogues.en: She smiled with a letter set on the table.
dialogues.text: She smiled with a letter set on the table.

dialogues.jp: 「手紙？」
dialogues.en: "Writing a letter?"
dialogues.text: "Writing a letter?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「文通の相手にお返事書いてるの」
dialogues.en: "I'm writing back to my pen pal."
dialogues.text: "I'm writing back to my pen pal."

dialogues.jp:
さりげなく内容を手でガードして、音夢がきれ
いに首を傾ける。
dialogues.en: Nemu tilted her head guarding the content of her letter.
dialogues.text: Nemu tilted her head guarding the content of her letter.

dialogues.en: "A guy?"
dialogues.text: "A guy?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「心配しなくても女の子――女の子かどうかは
　分からないけど、若い人だと思うよ」
dialogues.en:
"Don't worry, it's a girl. Well, I don't know for sure, but
somebody young."
dialogues.text:
"Don't worry, it's a girl. Well, I don't know for sure, but
somebody young."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……別に心配してるわけじゃないっての」
dialogues.en: "......I'm not worried."
dialogues.text: "......I'm not worried."

dialogues.jp:
鞄をソファーにおいて、冷蔵庫の中から麦茶を
だしてふたつのコップに注ぐ。
dialogues.en:
I put my bag on the sofa, and took cold tea out of the
refrigerator to pour it into to glasses.
dialogues.text:
I put my bag on the sofa, and took cold tea out of the
refrigerator to pour it into to glasses.

dialogues.jp: 「ほれ」
dialogues.en: "Here."
dialogues.text: "Here."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うわぁ、ありがと♪」
dialogues.en: "Wow, thank you!"
dialogues.text: "Wow, thank you!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「別にいいよ」
dialogues.en: "No problem."
dialogues.text: "No problem."

dialogues.jp:
音夢の隣に腰をおろして、はぁ、とため息をつ
く。
dialogues.en: I sighed as I sat down next to Nemu.
dialogues.text: I sighed as I sat down next to Nemu.

dialogues.jp: 「文通ってなにを書いてるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What do you write to your pen pal about?"
dialogues.text: "What do you write to your pen pal about?"

dialogues.jp: 机に上半身を投げ出して呟く。
dialogues.en: I covered the desk with my upper body, and mumbled.
dialogues.text: I covered the desk with my upper body, and mumbled.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「んー……うちには面倒くさがりの兄さんがい
　ますって」
dialogues.en:
"Well...... like I have a lazy brother who doesn't do
anything."
dialogues.text:
"Well...... like I have a lazy brother who doesn't do
anything."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……そうかいそうかい」
dialogues.en: "......Fine, I got it."
dialogues.text: "......Fine, I got it."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、兄さんのこと書いてるのは本当だけど。
　日記に近いかも」
dialogues.en:
"I'm joking. But I'm really writing about you. It's more
like a diary."
dialogues.text:
"I'm joking. But I'm really writing about you. It's more
like a diary."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「むぅ」
dialogues.en: "Huh."
dialogues.text: "Huh."

dialogues.jp:
確かに、俺達が日々に起こったことを書こうと
すれば、お互いが出てくるのは仕方ないか。
dialogues.en:
I guess we'll be in each others' diary if we write about
what happened in our everyday life.
dialogues.text:
I guess we'll be in each others' diary if we write about
what happened in our everyday life.

dialogues.jp:
「写真とかやりとりしてるのか？　あぁ、いや、
　さっき年齢も分からないって言ったか」
dialogues.en:
"Do you have a picture? Oh, that's right, you said you don't
know how old that pen pal was."
dialogues.text:
"Do you have a picture? Oh, that's right, you said you don't
know how old that pen pal was."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「うん。でも性格は分かるよ。やさしくて頭が
　よさそう……それでね、変な人」
dialogues.en:
"Yeah, but I know her character. Really nice, and smart, but
somewhat weird."
dialogues.text:
"Yeah, but I know her character. Really nice, and smart, but
somewhat weird."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp: 文通相手つかまえて変とはなんだろう。
dialogues.en: How could she call her pen pal a weird person?
dialogues.text: How could she call her pen pal a weird person?

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あのね、凄いんだよ……なんと職業が詩人さ
　んなんだって」
dialogues.en: "Listen to this...... she's a poet."
dialogues.text: "Listen to this...... she's a poet."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「詩人？」
dialogues.en: "A poet?"
dialogues.text: "A poet?"

dialogues.jp: 唐突にせつなさと、うさんくささが炸裂する。
dialogues.en: The sadness and suspicious feelings explode all of a sudden.
dialogues.text: The sadness and suspicious feelings explode all of a sudden.

dialogues.jp: 「俺の敵か？」
dialogues.en: "Is she my enemy?"
dialogues.text: "Is she my enemy?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……詩人を敵にする人ってどんな人よ」
dialogues.en: "......What kind of person will have a poet as an enemy?"
dialogues.text: "......What kind of person will have a poet as an enemy?"

dialogues.jp:
麦茶の入っていたコップを口にくわえて、ぶら
ぶらと上下に振る。
dialogues.en: I bit on the edge of the cup and swung it up and down.
dialogues.text: I bit on the edge of the cup and swung it up and down.

dialogues.jp:
「でも、詩人ってプロじゃなかったら、ただの
　フリーターだよな」
dialogues.en:
"But, if she isn't a professional poet, then she would be
just a jobless person, wouldn't she?"
dialogues.text:
"But, if she isn't a professional poet, then she would be
just a jobless person, wouldn't she?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「プロみたいだよ。うん、本も１冊もらったん
　だ。ちょっと待ってて」
dialogues.en:
"I think she's a pro. She gave me one of her books, hold
on."
dialogues.text:
"I think she's a pro. She gave me one of her books, hold
on."

dialogues.jp:
立ちあがって居間を出て行くと、すぐに１冊の
薄い文庫を手に戻ってくる。
dialogues.en:
She stood up and left the living room and came back with a
thin novel-size book in her hand.
dialogues.text:
She stood up and left the living room and came back with a
thin novel-size book in her hand.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ほら」
dialogues.en: "See?"
dialogues.text: "See?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「へぇ」
dialogues.en: "Wow."
dialogues.text: "Wow."

dialogues.jp: 結構きっちりとしている。
dialogues.en: It looks professional.
dialogues.text: It looks professional.

dialogues.jp:
白い背景に茶色い線で、どこか海沿いの草原の
風景が表紙に描かれている。
dialogues.en:
The picture of a meadow by the ocean was on the cover in
brown print on a white background.
dialogues.text:
The picture of a meadow by the ocean was on the cover in
brown print on a white background.

dialogues.jp:
ぽつん、と帽子をのせられた、１輪だけ咲いて
いる向日葵が印象的だ。
dialogues.en: One sunflower with a straw hat leaves an impression.
dialogues.text: One sunflower with a straw hat leaves an impression.

dialogues.jp: タイトルは……“水夏”。
dialogues.en: And the title was......"Water Summer."
dialogues.text: And the title was......"Water Summer."

dialogues.jp:
『彼の手はいつも冷たく　だから心が暖かい
　彼の顔はいつも冷たく　だから心が暖かい
　だから私が熱い時　彼は静かに手を伸ばす』
dialogues.en:
"His hand is always cold, that's why his heart is warm. His
face is always cold, that's why his heart is warm. That's
why he reaches out to me, when I'm hot."
dialogues.text:
"His hand is always cold, that's why his heart is warm. His
face is always cold, that's why his heart is warm. That's
why he reaches out to me, when I'm hot."

dialogues.jp: おそろしく緻密な手の挿絵。
dialogues.en: There was a detailed painting of a hand.
dialogues.text: There was a detailed painting of a hand.

dialogues.jp: 『西瓜　甘い　塩かけて　美味しい』
dialogues.en: "Watermelon, so sweet, sprinkle salt, so sweet."
dialogues.text: "Watermelon, so sweet, sprinkle salt, so sweet."

dialogues.jp: 縁側。風鈴と蚊取り線香と西瓜の絵。
dialogues.en:
A veranda. A picture of a wind-bell, mosquito repellant, and
a watermelon.
dialogues.text:
A veranda. A picture of a wind-bell, mosquito repellant, and
a watermelon.

dialogues.jp:
『夏は暑いから
　向日葵のお父さんに白い帽子をあげたら
　向日葵の子供さんの方にくたっと曲ったの』
dialogues.en:
"So hot in summer I gave father sunflower a white hat Then,
he leaned toward child sunflower."
dialogues.text:
"So hot in summer I gave father sunflower a white hat Then,
he leaned toward child sunflower."

dialogues.jp: 白い帽子をかぶせられた向日葵……。
dialogues.en: A sunflower with a white hat on top of it......
dialogues.text: A sunflower with a white hat on top of it......

dialogues.jp: 「……なんともコメントしづらいな」
dialogues.en: "......It's so hard to say anything about it."
dialogues.text: "......It's so hard to say anything about it."

dialogues.jp: ざっと中を見て呟く。
dialogues.en: I turned some pages.
dialogues.text: I turned some pages.

dialogues.jp: 見事に独特の世界観を形成している。
dialogues.en: She's made her own world.
dialogues.text: She's made her own world.

dialogues.jp: 理解できない……。
dialogues.en: But I can't understand it......
dialogues.text: But I can't understand it......

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あはははは。まぁね。でも、うん、だから面
　白いというか感性を刺激されるね」
dialogues.en:
"Hahaha. Yeah, I know what you mean. But that's what makes
it interesting, or should I say it stimulates your
emotions."
dialogues.text:
"Hahaha. Yeah, I know what you mean. But that's what makes
it interesting, or should I say it stimulates your
emotions."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そんなもんか」
dialogues.en: "Is that how it goes?"
dialogues.text: "Is that how it goes?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「でも、一番面白いのはその人の名前だよ。わ
　ざわざ巻末に書いてるからね」
dialogues.en:
"But the most interesting about it is her name. She put it
at the end of the book on purpose."
dialogues.text:
"But the most interesting about it is her name. She put it
at the end of the book on purpose."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「巻末？」
dialogues.en: "At the end of the book?"
dialogues.text: "At the end of the book?"

dialogues.jp: なんでそんなところに。
dialogues.en: Why would she do that?
dialogues.text: Why would she do that?

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「うふふふふ」
dialogues.en: "Teehee."
dialogues.text: "Teehee."

dialogues.jp: 音夢の笑い声を聞きながら、ページを手繰る。
dialogues.en: I turned the pages as she smiled.
dialogues.text: I turned the pages as she smiled.

dialogues.en: "The name is...... what?"
dialogues.text: "The name is...... what?"

dialogues.jp: 「らぶりー・ばーにんぐ！？」
dialogues.en: "Lovely Burning!?"
dialogues.text: "Lovely Burning!?"

dialogues.jp: びりびり、とショックで｛めまい／眩暈｝がする。
dialogues.en: It made me dizzy with shock.
dialogues.text: It made me dizzy with shock.

dialogues.jp:
確かにこれは表紙には書けない。これだけで、
全ての世界観を食ってしまうのだ。
dialogues.en:
This name ate the whole world she's created so far. This is
more shocking than the front page.
dialogues.text:
This name ate the whole world she's created so far. This is
more shocking than the front page.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あははははは♪　くすくす、あははは♪」
dialogues.en: "Hahahaha."
dialogues.text: "Hahahaha."

dialogues.jp: 音夢がお腹を抱えて笑う。
dialogues.en: Nemu started to laugh out loud.
dialogues.text: Nemu started to laugh out loud.

dialogues.jp:
多分、自分と同じことを俺がしてるからなんだ
ろうが……。
dialogues.en: It's probably because she's feeling the same as I am.
dialogues.text: It's probably because she's feeling the same as I am.

dialogues.jp: 「まったく……疲れる……」
dialogues.en: "It makes me tired......"
dialogues.text: "It makes me tired......"

dialogues.jp:
強烈なダメージに机につっぷして、しかし、口
元にはりついた笑みだけは消えなかった。
dialogues.en:
I couldn't wipe that smile off even as I crashed into the
desk with all the shock.
dialogues.text:
I couldn't wipe that smile off even as I crashed into the
desk with all the shock.

dialogues.jp: ◆音夢の文通相手◆
dialogues.en: ◆Nemu's poet pen-pal◆
dialogues.text: ◆Nemu's poet pen-pal◆

dialogues.jp:
学園から帰ると、机の上に便箋を広げて音夢が
文通を書いていた。
dialogues.en:
Nemu was writing a letter to her pen pal in the living room
as I came home from school.
dialogues.text:
Nemu was writing a letter to her pen pal in the living room
as I came home from school.

dialogues.jp:
何でも相手は詩人らしい。作品の内容は、なん
ともコメントしづらいものがあった。
dialogues.en:
Her pen pal's a poet. And the book she sent her was hard to
explain.
dialogues.text:
Her pen pal's a poet. And the book she sent her was hard to
explain.

dialogues.jp: 作者の名前は――らぶりー・ばーにんぐ。
dialogues.en: The name of the poet is---Lovely Burning.
dialogues.text: The name of the poet is---Lovely Burning.
